anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially restart or reconfigure the AI system to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate the performance and configuration of active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning and aligned with market conditions.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance and potential downtime, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating trading opportunities.
